component.name: Ducky Can Shoot
component.summary: Scan a USB medium for malware, archive it, share it and mail the verdict

description.p: Ducky Can Shoot (DCS) triages removable media: pick a plugged-in stick, scan every file with ClamAV and a built-in heuristic engine aimed at USB attacks, archive the medium into one image, upload that image to a free host and email the verdict, with the download link when the medium is safe.

If anything malicious is found, nothing is archived and nothing is uploaded, so malware never leaves the machine that owns the medium. Every stage reports what it did, why it was skipped and what it could not cover.
The interface is Qt Quick with Kirigami, so it follows the Plasma colour scheme and icon theme; the same pipeline is available as the `dcs` command for scripts.
